brief: Build a landing page for Ledgerline, a B2B invoicing and cash-flow forecasting SaaS for freelancers. Dark, editorial, high-contrast. Primary action: start a free trial.
Online shop for Terra & Fumée, a studio selling handmade stoneware ceramics. Warm, tactile, lots of photography. Needs product pages, cart and checkout.
Portfolio for a motion designer named Sora Kim. Playful but disciplined, bold typography, showreel first, case studies with video.
Design the web app dashboard for Routewise, a fleet logistics tool. Dense data, tables, map view, light theme, must be usable all day by dispatchers.
Website for Après, an independent online magazine about climate and cities. Serious long-form reading, serif typography, generous whitespace, newsletter as the main conversion.
Marketing site for Mutuelle Horizon, a regional credit union in France offering savings accounts and home loans. Trustworthy, calm, accessible to older users, French language.
Website for Kraft Kollektiv, a Berlin design studio. Brutalist, monochrome, oversized type, raw grid, almost no images. Work list, about, contact.
Landing page for Murmur, an AI meeting-notes app for small teams. Friendly, light, clean, with an interactive product demo in the hero. Convert to waitlist signups.
